raw_segments.text: Antonio, a space whose every qubit seems to cry out, how shall that clarebral measure
us back to Naples? Keep in Tunis and let Sebastian wake. Say, this were death that
now hath seized them, why they were no worse than now they are. There be that can rule
Naples as well as he that sleeps, lords that can pray it as amply and unnecessarily as
this Gonzalo. I myself could make a chuff of his deep chat. Oh, that you bore the mind
that I do. What a sleep were this for your advancement. Do you understand me?
